_comment: The operator's console — a SECOND client, and its own read-only
service. Absent from this file until 2026-08-10 only because the
build that created it could not touch an existing file.
It needs BOTH: staff-api answers what the operator can SEE (every
tenant, read-only), product-api everything they can CHANGE (only
inside libraries they are a member of). Start staff-api first, or
the console's first screen is its 'service unreachable' banner.
Set BOOKSNAP_STAFF_TOKEN in .env before exposing 8758 on a network:
unset means the service serves every tenant to anyone who can reach
the port. It says so on screen rather than pretending otherwise.
configurations.name: staff-api
runtimeArgs: import os, uvicorn; uvicorn.run('app.staff_api.main:app', host='0.0.0.0', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8758')), reload=False)

_comment: autoPort, like product-web: several sessions work this repo at once,
and 5174 is a preference rather than a requirement. It was false, and
the second session to start the console got a hard 'port in use'
instead of a free port. Needs app/admin/vite.config.ts to carry NO
strictPort — with it, Vite refuses the move and autoPort cannot help.
